name: stamp_mill
notes: Harlow's ten-stamp mill, built down the slope: the pan room at the front, the battery hall 3 m up on stone and the ore bin and rock-breaker floor 6 m up at the back, where the tram trestle comes in; the mill house is 11 m wide and 17 m deep under stepped tin roofs, and with the engine house, its 22 m stack and the water tank on the +X side the whole is 19 by 20 m across. Faces local -Z with the door there, stairs inside climb all three floors, and it carves nothing.
